notes.note: Follow-up delta review after push-hook findings: Assistant width selectors now precede and reuse the existing shared mobile shell query (768px or short coarse-pointer), replacing the added 600px at-rule. The assistant-only selector and desktop widths are unchanged; non-transcript controls described or captured here remain outside it. Inbox toolbar controls use 44px targets on every input type; Settle/Reopen use bundled Check/Refresh glyphs with their existing accessible labels. Grouping, identity, admission and disclosure behavior are unchanged. The turn browser uses the shared Empty/SkeletonList states and bundled outcome glyphs; metadata, paging, cancellation and row activation remain unchanged. Existing document classification and historical/platform/provider limits remain. This is review of the named source delta, not whole-document requalification.
